invariants.statement: MCP tool roots must canonicalize under configured workspace; escapes fail closed.
invariants.violate: MCP tools/call with root outside workspace succeeds without escape error

invariants.statement: Code Mode root_arg accepts OS paths without MCP-style workspace jail.
invariants.violate: Foreign absolute root on index_repo/search is rejected (would falsify free-root)

invariants.statement: Agent surfaces that accept project root enforce the same containment policy.
invariants.violate: MCP rejects outside root while Code Mode accepts it (observed)

invariants.statement: try_index_db_path order: explicit index_path > ASGREP_INDEX_PATH > active generation > local .asgrep/index.db > ASGREP_USE_CACHE path.
invariants.violate: Explicit index_path ignored in favor of ASGREP_INDEX_PATH

invariants.statement: Absolute ASGREP_INDEX_PATH/--index-path may resolve outside project root (privileged placement).
invariants.violate: Absolute outside-root path rejected as non-privileged

invariants.statement: MCP index_repo clears Searcher cache, advances generation, clears path registry and emitted snippets.
invariants.violate: Post-index_repo cache still holds pre-mutation Searcher or generation unchanged

invariants.statement: Code Mode index_repo clears warm Searcher cache before subsequent searches.
invariants.violate: Warm Searcher serves pre-mutation hits after index_repo (no parity test)
invariants.enforcement: Code present; generation model weaker than MCP; no unit test

invariants.statement: Batch never parallelizes when any call targets a non-read_only tool (e.g. index_repo).
invariants.violate: search+index_repo batch with parallel:true runs true parallel

invariants.statement: read_only=true means host-safe without approval; index_repo is sole catalog mutator (false); session does not gate approval.
invariants.violate: In-process session rejects index_repo without host approval (not implemented)

invariants.statement: A single agent client must load either Code Mode or MCP, never both.
invariants.violate: Both surfaces registered in one host with no runtime error

invariants.statement: Embed URLs fail closed on host allowlist/scheme; non-loopback http needs ASGREP_EMBED_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP; HTTP agent redirects(0).
invariants.violate: http://169.254.169.254 embed succeeds or allowlisted host 30x followed to disallowed hop

invariants.statement: Unknown ASGREP_DURABILITY does not select FastUnsafe; env falls back to Balanced default.
Hybrid semantic cannot introduce files outside cascade working set (subset of lexical survivors).
invariants.violate: Hybrid hit file with zero lexical prefilter membership

invariants.statement: Docs: empty structural stage yields no hybrid hits. Code/tests: lexical fallback + semantic may run (ht1h.3).
invariants.violate: Either side: empty-structural hybrid empty (violates code) or non-empty (violates doc)

invariants.statement: External ast-grep spawn requires ASGREP_ALLOW_AST_GREP and absolute existing ASGREP_AST_GREP path.
Pi planEdit refuses paths outside projectRoot; replace XOR write at boundary.
invariants.violate: Edit path resolves outside projectRoot and write proceeds

invariants.statement: Output limits clamp to 1..=MAX_OUTPUT_RESULTS (1000); queries longer than MAX_QUERY_CHARS (4096) rejected.
Hybrid multi-channel fusion uses weighted RRF; final order via finish_response; ranking oracle must_include holds on sample corpus.
invariants.violate: Oracle cases fail or fusion formula diverges without doc update
invariants.note: No published MRR/nDCG claimed here (benchmarks honesty policy)
